title: Personal data requests
description: Under the Personal Data Protection Act 2010, you have rights over how your personal data is handled. Choose a request type below to send your request directly to our privacy team.
rightsLinkText: Learn more in the Your rights section of our Privacy notice

copy.title: Get a copy of my data
copy.description: Request an export of the personal data we hold about you across tournaments, teams, and match records.

correct.title: Correct my details
correct.description: Ask us to update incorrect or outdated details, such as misspelled names or outdated information.

remove.title: Remove or hide my public profile
remove.description: Ask to remove your public player profile, hide specific details, or anonymise your public records.

withdraw.title: Withdraw consent
withdraw.description: Withdraw your consent or request limits on how your personal data is processed on the platform.

guardian.heading: Acting for a child under 18?
guardian.body: Parents and legal guardians can submit any of these requests on behalf of their child. Please mention that you are a parent or guardian when submitting your enquiry.
